import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp_tests')
from harness import ok, bad
P=[{"id":"p","max_aliases":1,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}]
def doc(zones, queries=None, obs=None):
    return {"zones":zones,"profiles":P,"queries":queries or [],"observations":obs or []}

z16=[{"origin":"z%d.test."%i,"records":[]} for i in range(16)]
ok(doc(z16)); print('16 zones ok')
bad(doc(z16+[{"origin":"zz.test.","records":[]}])); print('17 zones rejected')
z=[{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"h%d.test."%i,"type":"A","data":"10.0.%d.%d"%(i//256,i%256,1)} for i in range(1024)]}]
ok(doc(z)); print('1024 records ok')
z2=[{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"h%d.test."%i,"type":"A","data":"10.0.%d.%d"%(i//256%256,i%256,1)} for i in range(1025)]}]
bad(doc(z2)); print('1025 rejected')
r64=[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"TXT","data":"t%02d"%i} for i in range(64)]
ok(doc([{"origin":"test.","records":r64}])); print('64 distinct ok')
bad(doc([{"origin":"test.","records":r64+[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"TXT","data":"t64"}]}])); print('65 distinct rejected')
ok(doc([{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"TXT","data":"same"} for _ in range(64)]}])); print('dup collapse ok')
ok(doc([{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"b.test."},{"owner":"a.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"b.test."}]}])); print('dup cname ok')
bad(doc([{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"b.test."},{"owner":"a.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"b.test2."}]}])); print('2 cname targets rejected')
bad(doc([{"origin":"TEST.","records":[{"owner":"test.","type":"CNAME","data":"x.test."}]}])); print('cname at origin (case) rejected')
ok(doc([{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"sub.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"x.test."}]},{"origin":"sub.test.","records":[]}])); print('cname at other zone origin ok')
bad(doc([{"origin":"test.","records":[]},{"origin":"sub.test.","records":[{"owner":"sub.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"x.test."}]}])); print('cname at own origin rejected even if shadowed')
prof=[{"id":"p%d"%i,"max_aliases":0,"cname":"stop","wildcard":"off"} for i in range(8)]
qs=[{"id":"q%d"%i,"name":"a.test.","type":"A","cost":1} for i in range(20)]
ob=[{"id":"o%d"%i,"query":"q0","profile":"p0","result":{"status":"timeout"}} for i in range(64)]
r=ok({"zones":[],"profiles":prof,"queries":qs,"observations":ob})
print('max arrays ok', len(r['runs']), len(r['audits']), r['diagnostic']['equivalence'][:2], r['diagnostic']['basis'], r['diagnostic']['cost'])
bad({"zones":[],"profiles":prof,"queries":qs,"observations":ob+[{"id":"o99","query":"q0","profile":"p0","result":{"status":"timeout"}}]}); print('65 obs rejected')
bad({"zones":[],"profiles":prof+[{"id":"p9","max_aliases":0,"cname":"stop","wildcard":"off"}],"queries":qs,"observations":[]}); print('9 profiles rejected')
bad({"zones":[],"profiles":prof,"queries":qs+[{"id":"q99","name":"a.test.","type":"A","cost":1}],"observations":[]}); print('21 queries rejected')
# 128 observed answers ok / 129 rejected
ans=[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"TXT","data":"d%d"%i} for i in range(128)]
ok({"zones":[],"profiles":P,"queries":qs[:1],"observations":[{"id":"o","query":"q0","profile":"p","result":{"status":"response","rcode":"NOERROR","answer":ans}}]}); print('128 answers ok')
bad({"zones":[],"profiles":P,"queries":qs[:1],"observations":[{"id":"o","query":"q0","profile":"p","result":{"status":"response","rcode":"NOERROR","answer":ans+[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"TXT","data":"extra"}]}}]}); print('129 answers rejected')
